_doc: Oathwild attributes (PLAN §0 Guessed: the D&D six). js/rules/attributes.js is the ONE reader: it turns these into the character sheet. 10 is average; every point above or below 10 moves the numbers in `perPoint`. Point buy at creation (D&D 5e costs), +1 point at every even character level, and a class adds its own growth (classes.json `growth`). `farholdPlayer` is laid over Farhold's balance.player in memory so Farhold's own attribute weights are switched off (each multiplier is applied in exactly one place — lessons rule 33): Oathwild applies Strength/Dexterity/Constitution/Intelligence here instead.

blurbs.str: Heavy weapons hit harder, you carry more, and mail and plate need it.
blurbs.dex: Light weapons and bows hit harder, more critical hits and dodges, more stamina.
blurbs.con: More health and stamina, growing with every level; you carry a little more.
blurbs.int: Arcane, fire, frost, storm and shadow spells hit harder; more mana.
blurbs.wis: Holy and nature spells and every heal are stronger; mana comes back faster; resist magic.
blurbs.cha: Songs and summons are stronger, shops are cheaper, and companions hit harder.

pointBuy._doc: D&D 5e point buy: every attribute starts at 8 and 27 points raise them, up to 15 before class or level bonuses.

levelPoints._doc: +1 attribute point at every even character level (2, 4, 6, 8, 10).

perPoint._doc: What one point above 10 is worth (a point below 10 takes the same off). Shares are fractions: 0.035 = +3.5%.

base._doc: The numbers every character starts from before attributes, classes and gear. hp 46 -> 66 (owner 2026-11-26: a new hero died to one level-2 boar; a flat start mostly helps the first levels). meleePerLevel: a hero's weapon damage grows this share a character level (2026-11-26 balance: abilities grew ~9x from level 1 to 10, the weapon ~3x).

schoolAttr._doc: Which attribute powers a spell, by its element. `weapon` spells use the weapon in your hands instead (melee or ranged power).

farholdPlayer._doc: Laid over farhold/data/balance.json player in memory. Zeroes Farhold's own attribute weights and per-level health/mana (Oathwild's classes give those).

_farholdDexDoc: Farhold's derive adds Dexterity x0.2 critical chance and x0.3 dodge in code (not in balance), so attributes.js takes exactly that back off for gear Dexterity and applies Oathwild's own perPoint.dex once.
